thread:
Jordan (PM): Heads-up — we need a partner support escalation flow that covers cloud marketplace, hardware vendors, and SI partners. Goal: clear channel naming, runbook link, oncall handoffs, and an annual drill cadence. Who can take point on the draft?
Sam (Partner Eng): I can start a draft. Quick q: do we want a shared channel per partner or a single shared 'partner-war-room' with tags?
Alex (SRE): prefer per-partner channels for parallel incidents. Naming suggestion: `#partner-sev-<partner-short>-<env>` (e.g., #partner-sev-acme-prod). Keeps routing and perms simple. :+1:
Priya (Partner Ops): per-partner channels make sense. Also need a 'fallback' cross-partner channel for when vendor is unreachable. Maybe `#partner-sev-fallback`.
Eli (SE): FYI partners sometimes insist on their own SRE in the room. Add a step: invite partner liaison + vendor oncall, and have an internal liaison pinned.
Jordan (PM): Good. Also need standard escalation timings and who owns page/burn. Proposed P1: 0-30m ack, 30-60m engage vendor, 60-180m mitigation steps or exec notif. Thoughts?
Sam (Partner Eng): Agree on timings. Add an initial triage checklist in the runbook: symptoms, last deploy, model/version, request IDs, quick perf metrics. Keep it <7 bullets.
Alex (SRE): Add automated channel bootstrap: when we create a channel, InfraBot posts runbook template and includes oncall roster. Example command: `/create-partner-warroom acme prod --type=sev --include=vendor`
InfraBot: If invoked: "Created channel #partner-sev-acme-prod. Pinned runbook: https://redwood/runbooks/partner-sev-template. Notifying oncall rotation: @oncall-partners."
Priya (Partner Ops): Runbook link please include partner escalation matrix (vendor pager, partner comm lead, legal contact for breaches). We'll maintain a yaml snippet per partner in the repo.
Sam (Partner Eng): yaml snippet example pasted below for ops team to review:
```
partner: acme
vendor_oncall: +1-555-0100
liaison: priya@redwood.com
support_window: "24x7"
escalation_policy:
  p1: 30m-notify-vendor
  p2: 4h-expected-response
```
Eli (SE): Nice. Also add a pass-off template for handoff at shift boundaries and when we escalate to Dedicated or Private deployments.
Jordan (PM): Ops checklist for war room start: 1) create channel, 2) run InfraBot bootstrap, 3) invite partner liaisons, 4) post initial triage, 5) record commit / rollout IDs. Can someone put that into the runbook?
Sam (Partner Eng): I'll add the checklist to the draft runbook and open PR today.
Priya (Partner Ops): We should schedule a quarterly drill with top 5 partners. Recommend first drill next Tue 10am PT; 30m tabletop + 60m simulated war room. Volunteers to run the drill?
Alex (SRE): I'll run the simulation environment and provide synthetic alerts.
Eli (SE): I'll act as partner liaison for the first drill (play vendor).
Jordan (PM): Great. Action items: Sam — runbook PR (due in 48h). Priya — schedule drill and invite partners. Alex — prepare sim alerts. Eli — vendor role. Sam, when PR is ready ping @CloudPartnerOps and I.
CloudPartnerOps: Acknowledged — will coordinate invites and update partner contact records. Please include compliance tag for Private deployments.
Jordan (PM): Thanks team. We'll iterate on naming if partners push back. If no objections in 24h I'll merge the runbook and create template channels for the drill. :rocket:
Sam (Partner Eng): no objections from me.
Alex (SRE): same.
Priya (Partner Ops): +1
Eli (SE): +1
InfraBot: Reminder scheduled: "Quarterly partner SEV drill" on 2025-05-06 17:00 UTC
Jordan (PM): Closing the thread — moving action items into Asana and tagging owners.
